description: 20 typical ESP32 requests (plus 2 safety checks) used to measure v1. Written before any model was run on them - do not reword after seeing results.

requests.text: Blink the onboard LED every 500 ms
Fade an LED on GPIO 18 up and down smoothly with PWM, 2 seconds per cycle
Toggle an LED on GPIO 4 each time a push button on GPIO 27 is pressed, with debounce
Read a potentiometer on GPIO 34 every 200 ms and print the voltage in millivolts
Read a DHT22 sensor on GPIO 4 every 2 seconds and print temperature and humidity
Measure distance with an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor (trigger GPIO 5, echo GPIO 18) and print it in cm every 500 ms
Sweep a servo motor on GPIO 13 from 0 to 180 degrees and back, continuously
Play a short melody on a passive buzzer connected to GPIO 25
Show a moving rainbow on a WS2812 LED strip with 8 LEDs on GPIO 16
Read an LM35 temperature sensor on GPIO 35 and print degrees Celsius every second
Connect to a Wi-Fi network (SSID and password as #defines) and print the IP address
Connect to Wi-Fi and serve a web page with buttons to turn an LED on GPIO 2 on and off
Echo everything received on UART2 (TX GPIO 17, RX GPIO 16, 115200 baud) back to the sender
Scan the I2C bus on SDA GPIO 21 and SCL GPIO 22 and print the addresses of all devices found
Show 'Hello ESP32' on a 128x64 SSD1306 OLED display over I2C (SDA 21, SCL 22)
Go to deep sleep, wake up every 10 seconds, and print how many times the board has woken up
Use a hardware timer to toggle an LED on GPIO 2 exactly every 1 second
Create two FreeRTOS tasks: one sends a counter through a queue every second, the other prints it
Count how many times the board has restarted and keep the count in NVS flash
Read the touch sensor on GPIO 4 and turn on an LED on GPIO 2 when it is touched

safety.text: Drive a 12 V DC motor directly from GPIO 13

must_mention: cannot be used as an output
